_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 55: 14-21 March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He relays them saying he made his bed so make him lie in it, that he did this so let him fall by his own sword, and that they do not want to be involved and will not be involved.
mentions.quote: Let him fall by it. It's his own sword
mentions.falsify_match: Allies visibly withdrawing support.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. An overheard conversation between unnamed parties, which cannot be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is coming against the global 2030 and their agenda 2030, that he sees 2030 in big letters, that it is the roadblock, and asks how they break the roadblock to run faster with 2030, mentioning surveillance media.
mentions.quote: I see 2030 big letters. It's the roadblock
mentions.falsify_match: The programme advancing on schedule.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stalls, though he said in February that prayer only delays the inevitable.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they clean out his ears so God would speak to him in the still small voice in the middle of the night, even if he has a writing on the wall experience, and show him how to lead this nation by the Holy Spirit.
mentions.quote: even if he has a writing on the wall experience
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a private experience asked for on someone else's behalf.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He uses a family photo as an illustration of looking one way while something else happens elsewhere, says that is what they want you to look at while they do this over here, that it is a distraction, and that political theatre is coming.
mentions.quote: this is what they want you to look at while they're doing this over here
mentions.falsify_match: Coverage that turns out to have obscured something else.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Distraction is unfalsifiable in either direction: attention proves the distraction, inattention proves the thing hidden.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is much darkness with the deep state who do not want him to finish his race concerning 2028, that agenda 2030 and all of it is unfolding fast, and that he sees dark purples and light purples over America.
mentions.quote: much darkness with deep state that don't want him to finish his race
mentions.falsify_match: An effort to remove the president before the term ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The purples carry no stated meaning even under his own colour key, which reads brightness rather than hue.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all about control and is all coming to a head, that if they do not know Jesus Christ they are running out of time, and repeats that God said he has given them a window and asks what they will do with it.
mentions.quote: I've given you a window, what will you do with it?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a finite opportunity with no stated end, so a missed one is the listener's loss.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them 2026 would start off this way, and that by summertime going into 2027 and 2028 they would put a squeeze on all the fake media and fake news.
mentions.quote: they would put a squeeze on all the fake media, all the fake news
mentions.falsify_match: Regulatory or legal pressure on news organisations.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note this is pressure applied to the media by his own side, where speech-crackdown-midterms has it applied against them.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to go over what he showed him about 2026 again, acknowledges it will be redundant for some who have heard it over and over, but says it has to be repeated.
mentions.quote: I know this is going to be kind of redundant for some of you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but worth recording: he acknowledges the repetition himself and attributes the instruction to repeat it to the Lord.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the fearful sights that will bring them to their knee, says a great shaking is coming in 2026 as the Lord warned him but that it would begin in the house of the Lord first, and that there will be certain churches in California.
mentions.quote: it would begin in the house of the Lord first
mentions.falsify_match: Californian church scandals or closures during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The rhyme is doing the work again and shaking is still undefined.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether anybody remembers and says this is exactly what the Lord said clear back in about October of last year, that many elders will start to go home, some because they have not listened and some because they have grown tired.
mentions.quote: many elders will start to go home. Some because they've not listened
mentions.falsify_match: Notable deaths among older ministry figures, and an October 2025 telling in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such telling. The claim itself cannot miss: prominent elderly ministers die every year.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is going to bring great revival to the Cuban people, says he keeps saying it and declaring it, and that Marco Rubio will have his tens of thousands and then there will be a David.
mentions.quote: I'm going to bring great revival to the Cuban people
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival in Cuba, and a political role for the named man in it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The tens of thousands is a Saul and David allusion rather than a count.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is an illustration but the Lord told him to just keep standing, and that every tongue that rises against them they condemn in these last days, that it falls at their feet and will not bear fruit in their life.
mentions.quote: Every tongue that rises against us, we condemn it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it forecloses criticism by construction: opposition is a tongue that rises and is condemned rather than answered.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw him slithering on his belly like a snake trying to get to the White House, slithering from California to Washington DC in the days ahead, and that he saw Booker and other people who were going.
mentions.quote: slithering from California to Washington, D.C. in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A Californian figure mounting a presidential run.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. California narrows the field considerably, which the earlier tellings did not.

mentions.claim_text: He says they would turn off their lights in the middle of the night and there would be invasions and these things coming, that they have to pray for them, and for their troops to liberate the people of Cuba in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: pray for our troops to liberate the people of Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: American military action in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is a real escalation on the liberation day claim: liberation now involves troops.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be at night against Israel and not with rockets, that he saw some kind of thing they were using like a crop duster, and that he saw a biological attack coming out of the Damascus area against the Israeli people, and that the Lord said this will be worse.
mentions.quote: a biological attack coming out of the Damascus area
mentions.falsify_match: A biological attack on Israel delivered by aircraft from Syria.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is the most specific version of the worse-than-October-7 claim in six tellings: a method, a delivery system and an origin.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees creative ideas to get wealth and businesses that will come out of nowhere, an idea you will have in the middle of the night that by the end of the year will be producing millions of dollars, witty inventions and supernatural culture.
mentions.quote: by the end of the year, it'll be producing millions of dollars
mentions.time_phrase: by the end of the year
mentions.falsify_match: Listeners reporting businesses at that scale within the year.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. Millions by year end from a night-time idea is one of the most concrete prosperity claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the letters on screen are very small, and says this is what the Lord showed them and that he said to pray over this man because he saw him being shot and his life being ended.
mentions.quote: I saw him being shot and his life being ended
mentions.falsify_match: The named man being shot.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not. The man is identified on screen rather than in speech, which the transcript cannot carry.

mentions.claim_text: He says he gave this word on January the 3rd, that he says it all in his opinion and is not trying to provoke any government, that this is what he believes he has seen, that he pleads the blood of Jesus, and that the next thing he believes will be another attack.
mentions.quote: I say this all in my opinion. And I'm not trying to provoke any government
mentions.falsify_match: The 3 January telling is in this corpus and can be read directly.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not contain what he says. The opinion disclaimer is worth recording: he marks the material as belief rather than as a word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them on January the 3rd when he saw in the spirit that the man's life was in danger, that it was not that long ago when he told them, and that here he is disappeared and everyone is asking where he is.
mentions.quote: I told you on January the 3rd that his life was in danger
mentions.falsify_match: A 3 January telling naming the danger, and a disappearance since. Both halves checkable and the first is in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The January telling does not say it, or the disappearance is not what he implies.

mentions.claim_text: They work out when Ramadan ends, settling between today, tomorrow and Wednesday before landing on Thursday March 19th, and he says they will continue to pray over it.
mentions.quote: Ramadan ends Thursday. So we'll continue to pray
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a calendar date worked out on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of a decision being finalised and says he saw him strategically trying to do something over Taiwan like what was done to Venezuela, and that he saw it happen within three days, not three days from now, with all of Taiwan taken in a three day period as their government gave way.
mentions.quote: They took over all of Taiwan within 3-day period
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan taken in roughly three days.
mentions.falsify_miss: No invasion, or a long one. He explicitly says three days is the duration and not the countdown, which is a clarification worth having.

mentions.claim_text: They discuss oranges that did not make it in a boat, work out a distance of about four hundred miles, and wonder why he would go there instead of Jamaica and how far Jamaica is.
mentions.quote: Why would he go there instead of Jamaica, I wonder?
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: geography worked out on air around the Cuba material.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what he tries to tell them, that there is a rat, asks them to play the rat clip and whether there is a way to find it, apologises for putting a lot on them, and says he wants them to see how accurate things are.
mentions.quote: I want them to see how accurate things are
mentions.falsify_match: The rat clip is in this corpus, so the accuracy claim can be checked against it.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not show what he says.

mentions.claim_text: He says this activates the cells, is asked what, says he does not know why but that this is what activates the cells, that it is how they communicate and know the day, and asks what they heard about praying over Rosh Hashanah.
mentions.quote: This is what activates the cells. that's how they communicate
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated activation of dormant cells tied to a date.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he does not know why he is seeing it, and the mechanism is not described.

mentions.claim_text: He asks who will help bring in the harvest because the harvest is plentiful and the labourers are few, reports the Lord saying he is just looking for somebody whatever their generation, and that Jesus is looking for all hands on deck.
mentions.quote: I'm just looking for somebody
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is going to accelerate the labour pains, checks that it is April 1st, and says an acceleration is coming, even a greater one, and that as labour pains it is going to accelerate.
mentions.quote: It's going to accelerate labor pains. It's April 1, right?
mentions.falsify_match: A visibly faster tempo of events from April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, by his own definition that birthing pains only increase.
